% Checks cases the fix must not break: a bibliography in parts read by
% \input, subfiles' \subfile, and import's \subimport, which LaTeX writes
% to the document's own .aux.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{subfiles}
\usepackage{import}
\begin{document}
\input{test-bibinclude/input-cite}
\subimport{test-bibinclude/}{import-style}
\subfile{test-bibinclude/subfile-bib}
\end{document}
